detailed_descriptions.en: On the 27th consecutive night of working overtime, you finally return to your empty room and, as usual, switch on your computer. Instinctively, you add a game that catches your eye to your library. It’s your 1000th one. Unlike when you were a teenager, your enthusiasm for games has faded, and there’s no one left to play with. You drift off in your chair, only to awaken in a different world... Here, a mysterious tower has appeared out of nowhere. Robots roam the land, rounding up residents. Strange weather shifts without warning, and a colorful cast of characters awaits. This loss of passion for games is a condition known as V.E.D. Demeowrge, the God of Games, has prepared a special “treatment.” Fight, explore, and collect Buffs to rekindle your long-lost passion, complete the treatment, and return to the real world. Or stay. Embark on an adventure with 7 unique characters, each with their own abilities, playstyles, and personalities. These characters will join you as you unravel the mysteries of the world and fight your way through the game. Each character offers distinct action mechanics and upgrade paths, ensuring that every playthrough feels fresh and unique. Explore 9 core attributes and over 150 unique buffs that don't rely on standard numerical values. Departing from the traditional roguelike system, this game offers a fully customizable buff chain, allowing for endless combinations and interactions between buffs. Every battle becomes a new experience as you strategically trigger and connect buffs for an unparalleled combat style. Engage in fast-paced and intense combat, activate buffs through custom tactics, and use these upgrades wisely to overcome your enemies! The game features 4 large stages, each with its own distinct style, and 16 powerful bosses waiting to challenge you. Once you've mastered enough abilities, prepare for the ultimate test of skill as you block, dodge, and strike in exhilarating boss fights! Discover and collect over 50 pieces of unique equipment, including hidden traits that significantly impact your in-game buffs. Equip your character to maximize your advantage and defeat enemies with even greater efficiency.
